name: spinthewheel
description: Create interactive custom wheels, adjust weighted choices, and spin to make everyday decisions.

interface.longDescription: Turn a list from your conversation into an interactive spinner. Create 2–100 choices, set weighted odds, spin, edit labels and wheel colors, remove a winner, undo removal, reset, or continue with the same wheel on our website. Includes six built-in example wheels. Works as a guest with no account required. Where browser storage is supported, edits and results can reopen on the same browser for seven days; otherwise they last while the card is open. This version does not access accounts, synchronize saved wheels, search the live preset catalog, or certify prize draws.
defaultPrompt: Create a dinner wheel with pizza, dosa, pasta, and biryani.
Make a wheel from these names: Alex, Sam, and Jordan.
Help me choose options for a weekend activity wheel.
